D/ L AUREL COMMODVS AVG ; R/ TRP III IMP (II) COS PP

A complete silver Roman denarius of Commodus struck under Marcus Aurelius (175-192 AD). Mint: Rome, 178 AD. Reece Period 8. Cf. RIC III, p 266, No. 650 var. However, this obverse type is clearly not draped or cuirassed. Obverse: Laureate bust facing right. Obverse legend: L AUREL COMMODVS AVG. Reverse: Possibly Roma standing left, holding Victory and downward-pointing spear. Reverse legend: TRP…
